purpose: Known synthetic controls only; no manuscript target was scored.
reader_finding: On three known synthetic inputs, the recovered partition search failed both detection checks. Its 57–62% class-alignment measure did not mean complete recovery.
reader_limit: Explicitly selected main-tree key and puzzle texts only; not independent English validation or a historical replay. No manuscript target was scored.

panels.title: Known plants did not pass the detection gate
panels.metric: Source Part-C z and held-out z; higher than 3 is required

panels.title: Recovery depends on what is counted
panels.metric: Raw class-label agreement, one-to-one aligned agreement and source many-to-one row-max agreement; exact full recovery was zero of three.

limits: Three cases are not independent evidence about the whole proposed family.
Eight equal-budget shuffled fits per plant do not estimate a 99.9% envelope.
Source gate failures on known plants prevent using a future negative as a general exclusion.
